templates.author: zehfernandes
templates.code:
// emails/apple-receipt.tsx, from hyperelements.dev/templates. Render it with render(<AppleReceipt />) from
// "@hyper-elements/react"; your brand goes in ./brand.ts.

import { Column, Divider, Email, Heading, Image, LineBreak, Link, Row, Section, Text, token } from "@hyper-elements/react";
import { brand } from "./brand";

export const meta = {
  label: "App Store receipt",
  author: "zehfernandes",
  description: "A subscription's receipt: the order's details in a gray table, the app with its icon and price, the total, an offer, and the fine print",
  recreates: { company: "apple", what: "App Store receipt", original: "https://reallygoodemails.com/search/emails/Apple" },
};

// The app the receipt is for: no company's, so it reads the same in every brand.
const APP_ICON = "https://hyperelements.dev/generated/gallery/assets/companies/apple/app-icon.png";

export default function AppleReceipt() {
  const site = brand.links.site;
  // The logo as tall as the original's, whatever its shape.
  const logo = (height: number) => Math.min(160, Math.round((height * brand.logo.width) / brand.logo.height));
  const label = { fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 } as const;
  const cell = { padding: [token("spacing.sm"), token("spacing.md")], gap: 2, border: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.background") } } as const;
  const link = { color: token("colors.primary"), textDecoration: "none" } as const;
  const fine = { fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), lineHeight: 1.5 } as const;
  return (
    <Email
      width={640}
      title={`Your receipt from ${brand.name}`}
      previewText={`Your ${brand.name} receipt: Lumen Pro (Monthly), $14.99`}
      lang={brand.lang ?? "en"}
      dir={brand.dir}
      theme={brand.theme}
      fonts={brand.fonts}
      style={{ backgroundColor: token("colors.background"), color: token("colors.foreground"), fontSize: token("fontSizes.body"), lineHeight: token("lineHeights.body") }}
    >
      <Section style={{ padding: [token("spacing.md"), 0, token("spacing.xl")], mobile: { padding: [token("spacing.md"), token("spacing.md"), token("spacing.xl")] } }}>
        <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Image src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }} alt={brand.logo.alt} style={{ width: logo(42) }} />
            <Heading level={1} style={{ color: token("colors.muted"), textAlign: "right" }}>Receipt</Heading>
          </Row>
          <Text style={{ textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 700 }}>
            Save 3% on all your {brand.name} purchases with {brand.name} Card.¹ <Link href={`${site}/card`} style={link}>Apply and use in minutes</Link>²
          </Text>
          <Row style={{ backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"), borderRadius: token("radii.sm") }}>
            <Column>
              <Column style={cell}>
                <Text style={label}>{brand.name} Account</Text>
                <Text>alan.turing@example.com</Text>
              </Column>
              <Column style={cell}>
                <Text style={label}>Invoice date</Text>
                <Text>18 Jan</Text>
              </Column>
              <Column style={cell}>
                <Text style={label}>Order ID</Text>
                <Text>
                  <Link href={`${site}/account/orders`} style={link}>ML4F5L8522</Link>
                </Text>
              </Column>
              <Column style={cell}>
                <Text style={label}>Document no.</Text>
                <Text>186623754793</Text>
              </Column>
            </Column>
            <Column style={cell}>
              <Text style={label}>Billed to</Text>
              <Text>Visa .... 7461</Text>
              <Text>Alan Turing</Text>
              <Text>2125 Chestnut St</Text>
              <Text>San Francisco, CA 94123</Text>
              <Text>USA</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Text style={{ padding: [token("spacing.xs"), token("spacing.sm")], backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"), borderRadius: token("radii.sm"), fontWeight: 700 }}>
            {brand.name} Store
          </Text>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start", padding: [0, token("spacing.md")] }}>
            <Image
              src={{ src: APP_ICON, width: 120, height: 120 }}
              alt="Lumen"
              style={{ width: 64, borderRadius: token("radii.md"), border: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") } }}
            />
            <Column style={{ gap: 2 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Lumen: Photo Journal</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>Lumen Pro (Monthly)</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>Renews Aug 20</Text>
              <Text>
                <Link href={`${site}/store/review`} style={link}>Write a Review</Link> | <Link href={`${site}/store/report`} style={link}>Report a Problem</Link>
              </Text>
            </Column>
            <Text style={{ width: 90, textAlign: "right", fontWeight: 700 }}>$14.99</Text>
          </Row>
          <Divider style={{ borderTop: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") } }} />
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "end", gap: token("spacing.lg"), padding: [0, token("spacing.md")] }}>
            <Text style={{ ...label, fontWeight: 700, textAlign: "right" }}>Total</Text>
            <Text style={{ width: 90, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, textAlign: "right" }}>$14.99</Text>
          </Row>
          <Divider style={{ borderTop: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") }, padding: [0, 0, token("spacing.xl")] }} />
          <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.sm"), alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center" }}>
            <Heading level={2}>Save 3% on all your {brand.name} purchases.</Heading>
            <Text>
              <Link href={`${site}/card`} style={link}>Apply and use in minutes</Link>
            </Text>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={{ borderTop: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") }, padding: [token("spacing.xl"), 0, 0] }} />
          <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Text style={fine}>
              1. 3% savings is earned as Daily Cash and is transferred to your {brand.name} Cash card when transactions post to your {brand.name} Card account. If
              you do not have a {brand.name} Cash card, Daily Cash can be applied by you as a credit on your statement balance. 3% is the total amount of Daily
              Cash earned for these purchases. See the {brand.name} Card Customer Agreement for more details on Daily Cash and qualifying transactions.
            </Text>
            <Text style={fine}>2. Subject to credit approval.</Text>
            <Text style={fine}>Available for qualifying applicants in the United States.</Text>
          </Column>
          <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center" }}>
            <Text style={fine}>
              Privacy: We use a <Link href={`${site}/legal/privacy`} style={link}>Subscriber ID</Link> to provide reports to developers.
            </Text>
            <Text style={fine}>
              Get help with subscriptions and purchases. <Link href={`${site}/support`} style={link}>Visit {brand.name} Support.</Link>
            </Text>
            <Text style={fine}>
              You have the option to stop receiving email receipts for your subscription renewals. If you have opted out, you can still view your receipts in
              your account under Purchase History. To manage receipts or to opt in again, go to <Link href={`${site}/account`} style={link}>Account Settings</Link>.
            </Text>
            <Image src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }} alt={brand.logo.alt} style={{ width: logo(26) }} />
            <Text style={fine}>
              <Link href={`${site}/account`} style={link}>Account Settings</Link> • <Link href={`${site}/legal/sales`} style={link}>Terms of Sale</Link> •{" "}
              <Link href={`${site}/legal/privacy`} style={link}>Privacy Policy</Link>
            </Text>
            <Text style={fine}>
              Copyright © {brand.name}. <Link href={`${site}/legal`} style={link}>All rights reserved</Link>
              {brand.address ? <><LineBreak />{brand.address}</> : null}
            </Text>
          </Column>
        </Column>
      </Section>
    </Email>
  );
}

#CodePenChallenge: Cubes. The Shape challenge continues!͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ 

View this Challenge on CodePen

This week: #CodePenChallenge:
Cubes

The Shape challenge continues!

Last week, we kicked things off with round shapes. We "rounded" up the Pens from week one in our #CodePenChallenge: Round collection.

This week, we move on to cubes 🧊

Creating cubes in the browser is all about mastery of illusion. Take control of perspective and shadows and you can make the magic of 3D on a flat screen 🧙

This week is a fun chance to work on your CSS shape-building skills, or dig into a 3D JavaScript library like Three.js.

This week's starter template features an ice cube emoji to help inspire a "cool" idea for your Pen. As always, the template is just a jumping off point. Feel free to incorporate the 🧊 in your creation, add more elements, or freeze it out completely and start over from scratch!

💪 Your Challenge: create a Pen that includes cube shapes.

CodePen PRO

CodePen PRO combines a bunch of features that can help any front-end designer or developer at any experience level.

Learn More

To participate: Create a Pen → and tag it codepenchallenge and cpc-cubes. We'll be watching and gathering the Pens into a Collection, and sharing on Twitter and Instagram (Use the #CodePenChallenge tag on Twitter and Instagram as well).

IDEAS!

🌟

This week we move from 2 dimensions to three! Maybe you could exercise your perspective in CSS to create a 3D cube. Or, you can try out creating 3D shapes in JavaScript, using WebGL or building a Three.js scene.

🌟

There's more to cubes than just six square sides. There are variations on the cube that could be fun to play with this week: cuboid shapes are hexahedrons with faces that aren't always squares. And if you want to really push the boundaries of shape, consider the 4 dimensional tesseract!

🌟

Here's a mind-bending idea that can combine the round shapes from week one with this week's cube theme: Spherical Cubes 😳 Solving longstanding mathematical mysteries is probably outside the scope of a CodePen challenge, but you could use front-end tools to explore fitting spheres into cubes, or vice-versa.

RESOURCES!

📖

Learn all about How CSS Perspective Works and how to build a 3D CSS cube from scratch in an in-depth tutorial for CSS-Tricks. Or, check out stunning examples of WebGL cubes: Just Ice and Posing.

📖

Want to go beyond the square cube? Draw inspiration from Pens like Pulsating Tesseract, Rainbow Cuboid Loader, or Pure CSS cuboid jellyfish.

📖

Did that spherical cubes concept pique your interest? Explore Cube Sphere, 3D Sphere to Cube Animation With Virtual Trackball and Infinitely unpack prism for more mindbending cube concepts that test the boundaries of how shapes interact with each other.

Go to Challenge Page

You can adjust your email preferences any time, or instantly opt out of emails of this kind. Need help with anything? Hit up support.

[CodePen Challenges]

View this Challenge on CodePen (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes)

THIS WEEK: #CODEPENCHALLENGE:
CUBES

The Shape challenge continues!

Last week, we kicked things off with round shapes. We "rounded" up the Pens from week one in our #CodePenChallenge: Round (https://codepen.io/collection/challenge-round) collection.

This week, we move on to cubes 🧊

Creating cubes in the browser is all about mastery of illusion. Take control of perspective and shadows and you can make the magic of 3D on a flat screen 🧙

This week is a fun chance to work on your CSS shape-building skills, or dig into a 3D JavaScript library like Three.js.

This week's starter template features an ice cube emoji to help inspire a "cool" idea for your Pen. As always, the template is just a jumping off point. Feel free to incorporate the 🧊 in your creation, add more elements, or freeze it out completely and start over from scratch!

💪 Your Challenge: create a Pen that includes cube shapes. (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/starter)

[A cube puzzle on a yellow background]

CODEPEN PRO

CodePen PRO combines a bunch of features that can help any front-end designer or developer at any experience level.

Learn More (https://codepen.io/features/pro)

To participate: Create a Pen → (https://codepen.io/pen/new) and tag it codepenchallenge (https://codepen.io/tag/codepenchallenge) and cpc-cubes (https://codepen.io/tag/cpc-cubes). We'll be watching and gathering the Pens into a Collection, and sharing on Twitter (https://codepen.io/twitter) and Instagram (https://codepen.io/instagram) (Use the #CodePenChallenge tag on Twitter and Instagram as well).

IDEAS!

🌟

This week we move from 2 dimensions to three! Maybe you could exercise your perspective (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/perspective) in CSS to create a 3D cube. Or, you can try out creating 3D shapes in JavaScript, using WebGL (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/webgl) or building a Three.js scene (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/three-js).

🌟

There's more to cubes than just six square sides. There are variations on the cube that could be fun to play with this week: cuboid shapes (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/cuboids) are hexahedrons with faces that aren't always squares. And if you want to really push the boundaries of shape, consider the 4 dimensional tesseract! (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/tesseract)

🌟

Here's a mind-bending idea that can combine the round shapes from week one with this week's cube theme: Spherical Cubes (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/spherical-cubes) 😳 Solving longstanding mathematical mysteries is probably outside the scope of a CodePen challenge, but you could use front-end tools to explore fitting spheres into cubes, or vice-versa.

RESOURCES!

📖

Learn all about How CSS Perspective Works (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/css-perspective) and how to build a 3D CSS cube from scratch in an in-depth tutorial for CSS-Tricks. Or, check out stunning examples of WebGL cubes: Just Ice (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/just-ice) and Posing (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/posing).

📖

Want to go beyond the square cube? Draw inspiration from Pens like Pulsating Tesseract (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/pulsating-tesseract), Rainbow Cuboid Loader (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/rainbow-cuboid-loader), or Pure CSS cuboid jellyfish (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/cuboid-jellyfish).

📖

Did that spherical cubes concept pique your interest? Explore Cube Sphere (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/cube-sphere), 3D Sphere to Cube Animation With Virtual Trackball (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/sphere-to-cube) and Infinitely unpack prism (https://codepen.io/challenges/cubes/unpack-prism) for more mindbending cube concepts that test the boundaries of how shapes interact with each other.

Go to Challenge Page (https://codepen.io/challenges)

You can adjust your email preferences (https://codepen.io/settings/notifications) any time, or instantly opt out (https://codepen.io/unsubscribe) of emails of this kind. Need help with anything? Hit up support (https://codepen.io/support).

#KeelChallenge: Cubes. The Shape challenge continues!͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ 

View this Challenge on Keel

This week: #KeelChallenge:
Cubes

The Shape challenge continues!

Last week, we kicked things off with round shapes. We "rounded" up the Pens from week one in our #KeelChallenge: Round collection.

This week, we move on to cubes 🧊

Creating cubes in the browser is all about mastery of illusion. Take control of perspective and shadows and you can make the magic of 3D on a flat screen 🧙

This week is a fun chance to work on your CSS shape-building skills, or dig into a 3D JavaScript library like Three.js.

This week's starter template features an ice cube emoji to help inspire a "cool" idea for your Pen. As always, the template is just a jumping off point. Feel free to incorporate the 🧊 in your creation, add more elements, or freeze it out completely and start over from scratch!

💪 Your Challenge: create a Pen that includes cube shapes.

Keel PRO

Keel PRO combines a bunch of features that can help any front-end designer or developer at any experience level.

Learn More

To participate: Create a Pen → and tag it keelchallenge and cpc-cubes. We'll be watching and gathering the Pens into a Collection, and sharing on Twitter and Instagram (Use the #KeelChallenge tag on Twitter and Instagram as well).

IDEAS!

🌟

This week we move from 2 dimensions to three! Maybe you could exercise your perspective in CSS to create a 3D cube. Or, you can try out creating 3D shapes in JavaScript, using WebGL or building a Three.js scene.

🌟

There's more to cubes than just six square sides. There are variations on the cube that could be fun to play with this week: cuboid shapes are hexahedrons with faces that aren't always squares. And if you want to really push the boundaries of shape, consider the 4 dimensional tesseract!

🌟

Here's a mind-bending idea that can combine the round shapes from week one with this week's cube theme: Spherical Cubes 😳 Solving longstanding mathematical mysteries is probably outside the scope of a Keel challenge, but you could use front-end tools to explore fitting spheres into cubes, or vice-versa.

RESOURCES!

📖

Learn all about How CSS Perspective Works and how to build a 3D CSS cube from scratch in an in-depth tutorial for CSS-Tricks. Or, check out stunning examples of WebGL cubes: Just Ice and Posing.

📖

Want to go beyond the square cube? Draw inspiration from Pens like Pulsating Tesseract, Rainbow Cuboid Loader, or Pure CSS cuboid jellyfish.

📖

Did that spherical cubes concept pique your interest? Explore Cube Sphere, 3D Sphere to Cube Animation With Virtual Trackball and Infinitely unpack prism for more mindbending cube concepts that test the boundaries of how shapes interact with each other.

Go to Challenge Page

You can adjust your email preferences any time, or instantly opt out of emails of this kind. Need help with anything? Hit up support.

THIS WEEK: #KEELCHALLENGE:

The Shape challenge continues!

This week, we move on to cubes 🧊

Creating cubes in the browser is all about mastery of illusion. Take control of perspective and shadows and you can make the magic of 3D on a flat screen 🧙

This week is a fun chance to work on your CSS shape-building skills, or dig into a 3D JavaScript library like Three.js.

This week's starter template features an ice cube emoji to help inspire a "cool" idea for your Pen. As always, the template is just a jumping off point. Feel free to incorporate the 🧊 in your creation, add more elements, or freeze it out completely and start over from scratch!

💪 Your Challenge: create a Pen that includes cube shapes. (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/starter)

[A cube puzzle on a yellow background]

KEEL PRO

Keel PRO combines a bunch of features that can help any front-end designer or developer at any experience level.

Learn More (https://keel.example/features/pro)

To participate: Create a Pen → (https://keel.example/pen/new) and tag it keelchallenge (https://keel.example/tag/keelchallenge) and cpc-cubes (https://keel.example/tag/cpc-cubes). We'll be watching and gathering the Pens into a Collection, and sharing on Twitter (https://keel.example/twitter) and Instagram (https://keel.example/instagram) (Use the #KeelChallenge tag on Twitter and Instagram as well).

IDEAS!

🌟

This week we move from 2 dimensions to three! Maybe you could exercise your perspective (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/perspective) in CSS to create a 3D cube. Or, you can try out creating 3D shapes in JavaScript, using WebGL (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/webgl) or building a Three.js scene (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/three-js).

🌟

There's more to cubes than just six square sides. There are variations on the cube that could be fun to play with this week: cuboid shapes (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/cuboids) are hexahedrons with faces that aren't always squares. And if you want to really push the boundaries of shape, consider the 4 dimensional tesseract! (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/tesseract)

🌟

Here's a mind-bending idea that can combine the round shapes from week one with this week's cube theme: Spherical Cubes (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/spherical-cubes) 😳 Solving longstanding mathematical mysteries is probably outside the scope of a Keel challenge, but you could use front-end tools to explore fitting spheres into cubes, or vice-versa.

RESOURCES!

📖

Learn all about How CSS Perspective Works (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/css-perspective) and how to build a 3D CSS cube from scratch in an in-depth tutorial for CSS-Tricks. Or, check out stunning examples of WebGL cubes: Just Ice (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/just-ice) and Posing (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/posing).

📖

Want to go beyond the square cube? Draw inspiration from Pens like Pulsating Tesseract (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/pulsating-tesseract), Rainbow Cuboid Loader (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/rainbow-cuboid-loader), or Pure CSS cuboid jellyfish (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/cuboid-jellyfish).

📖

Did that spherical cubes concept pique your interest? Explore Cube Sphere (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/cube-sphere), 3D Sphere to Cube Animation With Virtual Trackball (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/sphere-to-cube) and Infinitely unpack prism (https://keel.example/challenges/cubes/unpack-prism) for more mindbending cube concepts that test the boundaries of how shapes interact with each other.

Go to Challenge Page (https://keel.example/challenges)

You can adjust your email preferences (https://keel.example/settings/notifications) any time, or instantly opt out (https://keel.example/unsubscribe) of emails of this kind. Need help with anything? Hit up support (https://keel.example/support).

This week: #PithChallenge:
Cubes

The Shape challenge continues!

Last week, we kicked things off with round shapes. We "rounded" up the Pens from week one in our #PithChallenge: Round collection.

This week, we move on to cubes 🧊

Creating cubes in the browser is all about mastery of illusion. Take control of perspective and shadows and you can make the magic of 3D on a flat screen 🧙

This week is a fun chance to work on your CSS shape-building skills, or dig into a 3D JavaScript library like Three.js.

This week's starter template features an ice cube emoji to help inspire a "cool" idea for your Pen. As always, the template is just a jumping off point. Feel free to incorporate the 🧊 in your creation, add more elements, or freeze it out completely and start over from scratch!

💪 Your Challenge: create a Pen that includes cube shapes.

Pith PRO

Pith PRO combines a bunch of features that can help any front-end designer or developer at any experience level.

Learn More

To participate: Create a Pen → and tag it pithchallenge and cpc-cubes. We'll be watching and gathering the Pens into a Collection, and sharing on Twitter and Instagram (Use the #PithChallenge tag on Twitter and Instagram as well).

IDEAS!

🌟

This week we move from 2 dimensions to three! Maybe you could exercise your perspective in CSS to create a 3D cube. Or, you can try out creating 3D shapes in JavaScript, using WebGL or building a Three.js scene.

🌟

There's more to cubes than just six square sides. There are variations on the cube that could be fun to play with this week: cuboid shapes are hexahedrons with faces that aren't always squares. And if you want to really push the boundaries of shape, consider the 4 dimensional tesseract!

🌟

Here's a mind-bending idea that can combine the round shapes from week one with this week's cube theme: Spherical Cubes 😳 Solving longstanding mathematical mysteries is probably outside the scope of a Pith challenge, but you could use front-end tools to explore fitting spheres into cubes, or vice-versa.

// emails/event.tsx, from hyperelements.dev/templates. Render it with render(<Event />) from
// "@hyper-elements/react"; your brand goes in ./brand.ts.

import { Button, Column, Email, Heading, Image, Link, Row, Section, Text, token } from "@hyper-elements/react";
import { brand } from "./brand";

export const meta = {
  label: "Event invitation",
  description: "An invitation: the event's name on a band of the brand's color, when and where, a button to register, and the day's schedule",
};

export default function Event() {
  return (
    <Email
      width={600}
      title="You're invited to Build Day"
      previewText="May 14, The Foundry. A day of talks and workshops for the people who build and ship software."
      lang={brand.lang ?? "en"}
      dir={brand.dir}
      theme={brand.theme}
      fonts={brand.fonts}
      style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.body"), lineHeight: token("lineHeights.body") }}
    >
      <Section style={{ padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.xl")] }}>
        <Image
          src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }}
          alt={brand.logo.alt}
          style={{ width: 140 }}
        />
      </Section>
      <Section
        style={{
          backgroundColor: token("colors.primary"),
          color: token("colors.primaryForeground"),
          padding: [token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")],
        }}
      >
        <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.sm") }}>
          <Text
            style={{
              fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"),
              fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: 1.5,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
            }}
          >
            You're invited
          </Text>
          <Heading level={1} style={{ color: token("colors.primaryForeground") }}>Build Day</Heading>
          <Text>A day of talks and workshops for the people who build and ship software.</Text>
        </Column>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.lg")] }}>
        <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 76 }}>
              <Column
                style={{
                  width: 76,
                  backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
                  borderRadius: token("radii.md"),
                  padding: [10, 0],
                }}
              >
                <Text
                  style={{
                    fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"),
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    letterSpacing: 1.5,
                    textTransform: "uppercase",
                    color: token("colors.primary"),
                    textAlign: "center",
                  }}
                >
                  May
                </Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.1, textAlign: "center" }}>14</Text>
              </Column>
            </Column>
            <Column style={{ gap: 2 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>May 14</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>9:30 AM to 6:00 PM</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>The Foundry, 120 Mill Street, Pittsburgh</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Button
            href={`${brand.links.site}/events/build-day`}
            style={{ borderRadius: token("radii.sm"), padding: [token("spacing.sm"), token("spacing.lg")] }}
          >
            Register for Build Day
          </Button>
        </Column>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")] }}>
        <Column
          style={{
            gap: token("spacing.sm"),
            border: { top: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") } },
            padding: [token("spacing.lg"), 0, 0],
          }}
        >
          <Heading level={2}>The day</Heading>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>9:30 AM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Doors open, coffee and breakfast</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>10:00 AM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Opening talk: shipping weekly without breaking anything</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>1:00 PM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Workshops, in four rooms</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>5:00 PM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Closing panel, then drinks on the roof</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
        </Column>
      </Section>
      <Section
        style={{
          backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
          padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.xl")],
        }}
      >
        <Text style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted") }}>
          {brand.name} · {brand.address}{" · "}
          <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/unsubscribe`}>Stop event invitations</Link>
        </Text>
      </Section>
    </Email>
  );
}

// emails/newsletter.tsx, from hyperelements.dev/templates. Render it with render(<Newsletter />) from
// "@hyper-elements/react"; your brand goes in ./brand.ts.

import { Button, Column, Divider, Email, Heading, Image, Link, Row, Text, token } from "@hyper-elements/react";
import { brand } from "./brand";

export const meta = {
  label: "Newsletter",
  description: "A regular issue: a masthead with the issue and date, a lead story, more stories with thumbnails, a closing note, and an unsubscribe footer",
};

export default function Newsletter() {
  return (
    <Email
      width={600}
      title="What's new this month"
      previewText="Faster exports, notes in your own voice, and a date for the open house"
      lang={brand.lang ?? "en"}
      dir={brand.dir}
      theme={brand.theme}
      fonts={brand.fonts}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
        fontSize: token("fontSizes.body"),
        lineHeight: token("lineHeights.body"),
      }}
    >
      <Column style={{ padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.md")], gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
        <Row
          stackOnMobile={false}
          style={{ alignItems: "center", gap: token("spacing.md"), padding: [0, token("spacing.sm")] }}
        >
          <Column>
            <Image
              src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }}
              alt={brand.logo.alt}
              style={{ width: 140 }}
            />
          </Column>
          <Column>
            <Text
              style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), textAlign: "right" }}
            >
              No. 14 · March 5
            </Text>
          </Column>
        </Row>
        <Column
          style={{
            backgroundColor: token("colors.background"),
            borderRadius: token("radii.md"),
            border: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") },
          }}
        >
          <Column style={{ padding: token("spacing.xl"), gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Text
              style={{
                fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"),
                fontWeight: 700,
                letterSpacing: 1.5,
                textTransform: "uppercase",
                color: token("colors.primary"),
              }}
            >
              This month
            </Text>
            <Heading level={1}>Exports that finish before your coffee does</Heading>
            <Text>
              We rebuilt the export pipeline from the ground up. Big projects that took minutes now take seconds, and there's nothing to change in your settings to get it.
            </Text>
            <Button
              href={`${brand.links.site}/blog/faster-exports`}
              style={{ borderRadius: token("radii.sm"), padding: [token("spacing.sm"), token("spacing.lg")] }}
            >
              Read about faster exports
            </Button>
          </Column>
          <Column style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")], gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
            <Divider />
            <Heading level={2}>Also in this issue</Heading>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start" }}>
              <Column style={{ width: 140 }}>
                <Image
                  src={{
                    src: "https://hyperelements.dev/generated/gallery/assets/images/recorder.png",
                    width: 1020,
                    height: 900,
                  }}
                  alt=""
                  style={{ width: 140, borderRadius: token("radii.sm") }}
                />
              </Column>
              <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
                <Heading level={3}>
                  <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/blog/your-voice`} style={{ textDecoration: "none" }}>
                    Notes that sound like you
                  </Link>
                </Heading>
                <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>
                  Release notes now start from what you've written before, so a first draft already has your voice.
                </Text>
              </Column>
            </Row>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start" }}>
              <Column style={{ width: 140 }}>
                <Image
                  src={{
                    src: "https://hyperelements.dev/generated/gallery/assets/images/shapes.png",
                    width: 1600,
                    height: 1200,
                  }}
                  alt=""
                  style={{ width: 140, borderRadius: token("radii.sm") }}
                />
              </Column>
              <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
                <Heading level={3}>
                  <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/blog/shared-boards`} style={{ textDecoration: "none" }}>
                    A new look for shared boards
                  </Link>
                </Heading>
                <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>
                  Boards you share outside your team get cleaner cards and a calmer layout.
                </Text>
              </Column>
            </Row>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start" }}>
              <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
                <Heading level={3}>
                  <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/events/office-hours`} style={{ textDecoration: "none" }}>
                    Office hours, every other Thursday
                  </Link>
                </Heading>
                <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>
                  Bring a question, or just listen in. We answer what you ask, live.
                </Text>
              </Column>
            </Row>
          </Column>
          <Column style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")] }}>
            <Column
              style={{
                backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
                borderRadius: token("radii.sm"),
                padding: token("spacing.lg"),
                gap: token("spacing.sm"),
              }}
            >
              <Heading level={3}>Come to the open house</Heading>
              <Text>We're opening the studio for an afternoon of demos and coffee. Bring a friend.</Text>
              <Button
                href={`${brand.links.site}/events/open-house`}
                style={{ borderRadius: token("radii.sm"), padding: [token("spacing.sm"), token("spacing.lg")] }}
              >
                Save a seat at the open house
              </Button>
            </Column>
          </Column>
        </Column>
        <Column style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.sm")], gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
          <Text
            style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            You're getting {brand.name}'s newsletter because you signed up for it.
          </Text>
          <Text
            style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            {brand.name}, {brand.address}
          </Text>
          <Text
            style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/unsubscribe`}>Unsubscribe from these emails</Link>
            {" · "}
            <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/account/emails`}>Choose which emails you get</Link>
          </Text>
        </Column>
      </Column>
    </Email>
  );
}

templates.code:
// emails/nike-shipping.tsx, from hyperelements.dev/templates. Render it with render(<NikeShipping />) from
// "@hyper-elements/react"; your brand goes in ./brand.ts.

import { Button, Column, Divider, Email, Heading, Image, Link, Row, Section, Text, token } from "@hyper-elements/react";
import { brand } from "./brand";

export const meta = {
  label: "It's on its way",
  author: "zehfernandes",
  description: "An order that has shipped: the tracking number and a button up top, a bold headline, where it's going, the item with its picture, picks for you, and help",
  recreates: { company: "nike", what: "shipping confirmation", original: "https://reallygoodemails.com/search/emails/Nike" },
};

const ASSETS = "https://hyperelements.dev/generated/gallery/assets/companies/nike/";
const PICKS = [
  { image: "pick-1.jpg", name: "USWNT Stadium Home", kind: "Women's Dri-FIT Soccer Jersey" },
  { image: "pick-2.jpg", name: "Brazil Stadium Goalkeeper", kind: "Men's Dri-FIT Short-Sleeve Football Shirt" },
  { image: "pick-4.jpg", name: "FFF", kind: "Women's Soccer Jacket" },
];

export default function NikeShipping() {
  const site = brand.links.site;
  const host = new URL(site).host.replace(/^www\./, "");
  const rule = { borderTop: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") } } as const;
  const band = { padding: [token("spacing.md"), token("spacing.lg")], mobile: { padding: [token("spacing.md"), token("spacing.md")] } } as const;
  const muted = { color: token("colors.muted") } as const;
  const outline = {
    width: 220,
    padding: [10, 0],
    textAlign: "center",
    fontSize: 16,
    color: token("colors.foreground"),
    backgroundColor: token("colors.background"),
    border: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.muted") },
    borderRadius: token("radii.sm"),
  } as const;
  const help = { color: token("colors.foreground"), textDecoration: "underline" } as const;
  return (
    <Email
      width={600}
      title="It's On Its Way."
      previewText="Get your order summary, estimated delivery date and more"
      lang={brand.lang ?? "en"}
      dir={brand.dir}
      theme={brand.theme}
      fonts={brand.fonts}
      style={{ backgroundColor: token("colors.background"), color: token("colors.foreground"), fontSize: token("fontSizes.body"), lineHeight: token("lineHeights.body") }}
    >
      <Section style={{ border: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") } }}>
        <Column>
          <Row style={{ ...band, backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"), alignItems: "center", gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Tracking Number</Text>
              <Text style={muted}>1ZV218970300071628</Text>
            </Column>
            <Button href={`${site}/orders/track`} style={outline}>Track Package</Button>
          </Row>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={{ padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.xl")], gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center", mobile: { padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.md")] } }}>
            <Image
              src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }}
              alt={brand.logo.alt}
              style={{ width: Math.min(160, Math.round((26 * brand.logo.width) / brand.logo.height)) }}
            />
            <Heading level={1}>It's On Its Way.</Heading>
            <Text style={muted}>Your order is on its way. Use the link above to track its progress.</Text>
            <Text style={muted}>
              We've also charged your payment method for the cost of your order and will be removing any authorization holds. For payment details, please
              visit your Orders page on {host} or in the {brand.name} app.
            </Text>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={band}>
            <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Shipping to: Alan Turing</Text>
            <Text style={muted}>2125 Chestnut St, San Francisco, CA 94123</Text>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Row style={{ ...band, padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.lg")], gap: token("spacing.sm"), alignItems: "start" }}>
            <Image src={{ src: `${ASSETS}product.jpg`, width: 560, height: 560 }} alt="Brazil Stadium Away Women's Dri-FIT Soccer Jersey" style={{ width: 260 }} />
            <Column>
              <Text>Brazil Stadium Away Women's Dri-FIT Soccer Jersey</Text>
              <Text style={muted}>Size L (12–14)</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={{ ...band, gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
            <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
              <Column style={{ width: 170 }}>
                <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Order Number</Text>
                <Text style={muted}>C0106373851</Text>
              </Column>
              <Column>
                <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Order Date</Text>
                <Text style={muted}>Sep 22</Text>
              </Column>
            </Row>
            <Column style={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <Button href={`${site}/orders`} style={outline}>Order Status</Button>
            </Column>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={{ padding: [token("spacing.md"), token("spacing.xs")], gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Heading level={2} style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>Top Picks For You</Heading>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
              {PICKS.map((pick) => (
                <Column key={pick.image} style={{ gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
                  <Image src={{ src: `${ASSETS}${pick.image}`, width: 320, height: 400 }} alt={`${pick.name} ${pick.kind}`} style={{ width: "100%" }} />
                  <Column style={{ padding: [token("spacing.xs"), 10] }}>
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{pick.name}</Text>
                    <Text style={{ ...muted, fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{pick.kind}</Text>
                  </Column>
                </Column>
              ))}
            </Row>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={{ ...band, backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"), gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Get Help</Text>
            <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/help/shipping-status`} style={help}>Shipping Status</Link></Text>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/help/shipping-delivery`} style={help}>Shipping & Delivery</Link></Text>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/help/returns`} style={help}>Returns & Exchanges</Link></Text>
            </Row>
            <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/help/how-to-return`} style={help}>How to Return</Link></Text>
              <Text style={{ flex: 2 }}><Link href={`${site}/help/contact`} style={help}>Contact Options</Link></Text>
            </Row>
            <Divider style={rule} />
            <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
              <Text>1-800-806-6453</Text>
              <Text>4 am - 11 pm PT</Text>
            </Row>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={{ ...band, gap: token("spacing.sm"), alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center" }}>
            <Heading level={2}>{host}</Heading>
            <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), justifyContent: "center" }}>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/men`} style={help}>Men</Link></Text>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/women`} style={help}>Women</Link></Text>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/kids`} style={help}>Kids</Link></Text>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/customize`} style={help}>Customize</Link></Text>
            </Row>
          </Column>
          <Divider style={rule} />
          <Column style={{ ...band, gap: token("spacing.sm"), alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center" }}>
            <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), justifyContent: "center" }}>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/email/web-version`} style={{ ...help, color: token("colors.muted") }}>Web Version</Link></Text>
              <Text><Link href={`${site}/legal/privacy`} style={{ ...help, color: token("colors.muted") }}>Privacy Policy</Link></Text>
            </Row>
            <Text style={muted}>Please contact us if you have any questions. (If you reply to this email, we won't be able to see it.)</Text>
            <Text style={muted}>© {brand.name}. All Rights Reserved.</Text>
            {brand.address ? <Text style={muted}>{brand.name}, {brand.address}</Text> : null}
          </Column>
        </Column>
      </Section>
    </Email>
  );
}

Tips and tricks for searching on Stack Overflow

Searching for solutions

With more than 18 million questions, it's possible that someone has already provided a solution to the problem you're facing.

 

Use the search bar at the top of the page to find what you need

Here are a few simple search tips to get you started:

•
To find a specific phrase, enter it in quotes: "local storage"
•
To search within specific tag(s), enter them in square brackets: [javascript]
•
Combine them to get even more precise results - [javascript] "local storage" searches for the phrase “local storage” in questions that have the [javascript] tag

The more information you can put in the search bar, the more likely you will be to either find the answer you need or feel confident that no one else has asked the question before.

You're now ready to make live transactions with Stripe!͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ 
 

Thanks for submitting your account information. You're now ready to make live transactions with Stripe!

You can view your payments and a variety of other information about your account right from your dashboard.

View your Stripe Dashboard
 

If you haven't finished your integration, you might find our docs handy.

Once you're ready to start accepting payments, you'll just need to use your live API keys instead of your test API keys. Your account can simultaneously be used for both test and live requests, so you can continue testing while accepting live payments. Check out our tutorial about account basics.

Finally, we've put together a quick checklist to ensure your website conforms to card network standards.

We'll be here to help you with any step along the way. You can find answers to most questions and get in touch with us on our support site.

— The Stripe team
